analysis.title: GS Futures Global Equity CTA - Market Update - November 17, 2026
key_insights: GS Futures Sales Strats estimates CTAs reduced global equity net length by $3bn last week.
The desk's simulation has CTAs selling $23bn of SPX over the past week and $46.5bn over the past month.
As of Friday's close (Nov 13), CTAs are estimated to be mildly short $3bn of SPX.
SPX price action late last week flipped medium-term momentum positive again, so the desk expects modest CTA buying this week.
The desk anticipates CTAs will buy $10.5bn of SPX over the next week.
Spot SPX sits near the medium-term momentum threshold, so the desk expects variability in the flow forecasts until a more definitive trend is established.
risk_factors: Because SPX spot is near the medium-term momentum threshold, a small move could change the sign of the forecast CTA flows.
The figures are simulated and backtested, and GS gives no assurance the model operated or would operate as shown.
